lines: Oh! Hi! I'm Pip. Are you a lamp? You're kind of glowy.
Nina: I'm Nina. Not a lamp.
The portal is the biggest, glowiest light EVER.
I just want to look at it a tiny bit. Okay, a big bit. Okay, ALL the bits.
Can't stop! The lamps are coming on! See you on the boardwalk!
(yawn) The sky's getting light... home to my cave. Night night, Nina.
(yawn) Too bright... come back when it's dark and sparkly...
It's getting dark! The lamps are coming on! Best part of the whole day!

rotate: Lamp! Lamp! Lamp! Did you see that lamp? It's SO round.
Want to go lamp watching with me?

lines: Yay! Lamp number one is... that one.
Lamp number two is... also that one. It's my favorite.
Okay! The lamps will wait. Lamps are very patient.

rotate: I counted all the lamps on the boardwalk. There are... a lot! I got too excited to finish.
